title: Sealed-breadth RPCD finite-time exploration
objective: From the minimal normalized RPCD statement, generate and lock an Agent-authored route card before seeing research history; then attack its first falsifiable edge and determine whether the route can advance C050 without assuming the stronger certificate C051.
acceptance_checks: The Agent-generated route_card.json is written first, hashed, and remains unchanged after context reveal; no coordinator precommit is submitted as the Agent card.
The primary state and core lemma match the rollout's assigned method_family and are mathematically distinct from the other fanout families.
The argument targets C050 directly and never assumes C051 or treats it as equivalent.
At least two analytic falsifiers are applied, including a noncommuting and a near-singular unit-diagonal SPD family.
Any rate controls non-normal prefactors and proves expectation of distance for every initial point, not distance of the expected iterate.
Numerical null results remain E1 and every general statement stops at E3 pending a different-run audit.

denylist: research/routes/** except the single allowlisted minimal specification

required_differences: Commit to the representation named by the rollout before inherited context is revealed.
State a falsifiable core lemma and identify the first bad edge rather than offering an untestable analogy.
Transfer directly to C050 without assuming C051 or silently changing expected distance into distance of expectation.
forbidden_methods: copying any coordinator-precommitted route before the statement-only card is locked
distance of the expected iterate in place of expected distance
required_controls: unit-diagonal SPD normalization and fresh independent epoch permutations
full-space versus reachable-state and finite-time versus asymptotic semantics
